seo.title: Barber Blog: Cuts, Care & Booking | Carlsbad, NM
seo.description: Haircut guides, grooming care and booking tips from Tim Murillo, the barber behind Divinely Faded at 303 S Halagueno St in Carlsbad, NM.

paragraphs: Guides to the cuts I do every week, how to keep them sharp between visits, and how booking works at my shop on Halagueno Street in Carlsbad.

Everything here comes from my own chair: the Essential Haircut, the Signature Cut and the Luxury Grooming Experience, straight razor shaves, facials, braids, hair designs, color and perms. If a post talks about price or time, it's the same price and time you'll see on Booksy.
Got a question you want answered here? Text me at {{phone}}.

blocks.heading: Read up.
blocks.empty: The first posts go up soon. Until then, the style library has a page for every cut I do, with real photos from the shop, and the FAQ covers hours, payment, holidays and how long each service takes.
blocks.lead: Style guides, care between cuts and the details of booking, newest first.
